assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, occurring in the context of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate and rhythm control strategies.
The diagnoses of syncope (R55) and transient cerebral ischemic attack (G45.9) support the medical necessity of this diagnostic procedure.
The procedure is mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229).
The claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on reason code CO-197.
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
SilverBridge Advantage requires prior approval for this specific diagnostic procedure.
This decision does not preclude the possibility of future coverage if proper authorization is secured.
